claims.value: GKA-primed-HQwen3-8B-Instruct is a hybrid causal language model with 50% Attention and 50% Gated KalmaNet (GKA) layers, primed from Qwen3-8B. It is instruction-tuned, supports context lengths up to 128K tokens, and is not a thinking model (does not natively produce chain-of-thought). Tool calling is not supported by this checkpoint.
claims.evidence: GKA-primed-HQwen3-8B-Instruct is a Hybrid language model consisting of 50% Attention layers and 50% [Gated KalmaNet (GKA)]... model is instruction-tuned and supports context lengths up to 128K tokens... Tool calling is not supported by this checkpoint.
Type: Causal Language Model (Hybrid Attention + SSM)
Note, this is an Instruction-tuned model and is not a thinking model, that is, it does not natively produce chain-of-thought thinking tokens in its generation trace.
